window.__dbg (free camera, frame stepping and screenshot capture) is now
defined only on the Vite dev server, so the published game no longer
exposes it.

Add AQUA BLUE, a browser underwater exploration and photo game

A 3D diving game built with Three.js and Vite. Explore a coral garden,
manta pinnacles, a sunken temple and a blue grotto, photograph 20 kinds
of sea life for the field guide, and collect the memory fragments of a
sunken island. Terrain, creatures, ruins, the boat, music and sound are
all generated in code. Includes the README with screenshots, the MIT
license and a GitHub Pages deploy workflow.
